source.original_question: Find h to one decimal place.

adaptations.reason: Source golden pyramid decoration replaced by its visible isosceles triangular cross-section; the same height,base,base-angle relation is kept and explicitly stated.

independent_solution.method: The altitude bisects the isosceles base10.6, giving halfbase5.3. h=5.3tan40°=4.4472..., rounds4.4m.
